# FDG2013

> DO provide simple overloads of constructors and methods. A simple overload has a very small number of parameters, and all parameters are primitives.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 2.2.2 The Principle of Low Barrier to Entry.

## How it is checked

- Check: judgment
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test none
- Status: verified

Not an analyzer candidate: which constructors and methods need a simple overload depends on the main scenarios, so a check would have to guess intent.
